title: Vinyl Plank Flooring quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install 'Coastal Living' Hybrid Vinyl Plank Flooring (1800mm x 228mm x 6.5mm, Spotted Gum finish) in a ground-floor Sydney suburban home. This includes removal and disposal of existing carpet and underlay from the living room (35 sqm), hallway (10 sqm), and two bedrooms (10 sqm each), totalling 65 square metres. Installation will cover these 65 square metres. Supply and install 50 linear metres of matching scotia. Supply and install six T-bar transition strips for doorways. Apply one coat of moisture barrier to the concrete slab subfloor. Includes standard subfloor preparation.
workingDetail: Hybrid / luxury vinyl plank flooring, Underlay (if not pre-attached), Transition strips (T-bar, reducer, end cap), Scotia or quarter round
